top_signal.title: Graphic Design - inexpensive options?
top_signal.summary: Good morning everyone,   I am starting up a small e-commerce operation that I eventually envision transitioning into having a local retail branch.   I am bootstrapping this myself so trying to maintain a tight budget and being cost responsible and spending money on early inventory and focusing on honing that and investing in quality inventory first vs selling generic items in my store. I also am designating investment in my operations beforehand so I don't have early customer service issues.    I have a need for graphic design for multiple reasons, ads, product packaging, logo design, etc.   I myself am not necessarily against limited generative AI usage, but I want to avoid it because I know it's very controversial with my audience (creatives will be part of my targeted demographics for my products). I've gotten a few quotes from local designers on some things and while I respect their art and craft, I simply can't afford those luxury rates at this point. Frankly I'm not sure how anyone who's not wildly profitable works with some of these people, the rates are eye watering, but I understand the concept of not underselling yourself, so it makes sense.   I have seen some designers on the various services like fiverr, etc and I'm wondering if others have experience with those or other services and if they've had good results, and if you have any tips on how to utilize them most effectively.
